Package edu.odu.cs.cs350

Record Class Section

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.odu.cs.cs350.Section
Record Components:
CRN - unique identifier for each section
subject - Identifies the department offering the course
CourseNumber - Course number (e.g CS - 350)
CrossListCap - (cross-list cap) The maximum number of students that can enroll in this section.
ENR - Number of students enrolled in this section
LINK - labs or recitations associated lecture
crossListGroup - (cross-list group) links section(s) to an offering
overallEnrollmentCap - maximum number of students that can enroll in the offering to which this section belong
overallEnrollment - total number of students enrolled in the offering to which this section belongs
public record Section(int CRN, String subject, String CourseNumber, int CrossListCap, int ENR, String LINK, String crossListGroup, int overallEnrollmentCap, int overallEnrollment) extends Record

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
